description: This file defines the IStreamProvider interface and associated extension methods used for providing and accessing streams within the Orleans streaming framework. It includes method signatures to retrieve streams by various identifiers and properties indicating provider capabilities.

classes.name: StreamProviderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IStreamProvider to facilitate getting streams with various identifiers.

methods.name: GetStream<T>(this IStreamProvider streamProvider, Guid id)
methods.description: Retrieves a stream given a GUID identifier.

methods.name: GetStream<T>(this IStreamProvider streamProvider, string ns, Guid id)
methods.description: Retrieves a stream given a namespace and GUID identifier.

methods.name: GetStream<T>(this IStreamProvider streamProvider, string id)
methods.description: Retrieves a stream given a string identifier.

methods.name: GetStream<T>(this IStreamProvider streamProvider, string ns, string id)
methods.description: Retrieves a stream given a namespace and string identifier.

methods.name: GetStream<T>(this IStreamProvider streamProvider, long id)
methods.description: Retrieves a stream given a long identifier.

methods.name: GetStream<T>(this IStreamProvider streamProvider, string ns, long id)
methods.description: Retrieves a stream given a namespace and long identifier.
